title: Pix fraud marker status change
description: Pix fraud marker integrity status change. The following endpoints generate this event: Create fraud marker. For more information, see the Pix instant payments guide. Also see the Pix payments data events guide.

document_number.title: Document Number
document_number.description: A government document number, such as a Social Security number (US) or Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas number (Brazil). Must be numeric with 11-14 digits.

key.title: Pix key
key.description: Key to which the fraud marker will be associated. It must be reported, if known.

bacen_creation_datetime.title: Bacen creation datetime
bacen_creation_datetime.description: Fraud marker creation datetime. A RFC 3339 date-time value, i.e., '2023-04-12T23:20:50.52Z'

bacen_last_modified_datetime.title: Bacen last modified datetime
bacen_last_modified_datetime.description: Fraud marker last modified datetime. A RFC 3339 date-time value, i.e., '2023-04-12T23:20:50.52Z'
